import re
GROUP = re.compile(r'^@(?P<group>[\w-]+)\s*$')
DESC = re.compile(r'^\s+#\s*(?P<description>\S.*?)\s*$')
CALL = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<syscall>[@\w-]+)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    recs, used = [], []
    group, desc = '', ''
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = GROUP.match(ln)
        if m:
            group, desc = m.group('group'), ''
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = DESC.match(ln)
        if m:
            desc = (desc + ' ' + m.group('description')).strip()
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = CALL.match(ln)
        if m and group:
            recs.append({'group': group, 'description': desc, 'syscall': m.group('syscall')})
            used.append(i)
    return [{'name': 'syscalls', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}]
